Sounak Banik / In practice

A designer’s eye.
A developer’s
follow-through.

I design and build websites and SaaS products. I stay with the work from the first rough idea to the last interaction, so the details survive the handover.

For founders and teams who want someone to think it through, make it clear, and make it work.

01Find the form +

Visual direction, interface design, and a story people can follow. A clear point of view before the build.

02Make it respond +

Frontend development, responsive layouts, and interactions that make the next move feel obvious.

03Close the loop +

Motion, accessibility, and performance. The finishing work that makes a site feel considered on every screen.
